title: Agent orchestration
summary: How your agent reasons: turns, tool selection, chained execution and automatic toll payment.

items: You send text or voice (the sandbox and the device hit the same gateway).
brain authenticates your Bearer against the api and resolves YOUR context: provider, model, network, wallet and dapps.
The LLM receives the message + the catalog of available tools and decides what to call.
The api executes each tool (app ones pay their x402 toll) and returns results to the model.
The model may chain more calls until it answers in plain language.

blocks.title: No provider, no reasoning
blocks.text: If your account has no active provider, the gateway demands one: it never uses global keys or another account's.

When a tool touches a protected resource, the api issues a 402 invoice and your account's dPaaS wallet settles it (dPaaS = automatic delegated payment). The turn continues without you signing anything; each invoice is consumed exactly once.
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/agent/gateway -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Cookie: $SESSION" -d '{"text":"API health status"}' | jq '{ok, tools_used, backend}'

The panel's sandbox mode is your ephemeral test bench: same provider, model, dapps and wallet, but sessioned in the browser. Test turns use your real parameters; the separate sandbox/production usage metering arrives with the api's per-account counter.
